title: Distance Is Not a Spiritual Test
core_idea: Within the twin flame belief, someone stepping away is an answer to respect, not a test to pass; a true connection would feel mutual and free rather than like pursuit.
text: In the twin flame belief, there's a familiar story: one person runs, the other chases, and the distance is said to be part of the journey. It's worth pausing on that idea gently. If someone keeps stepping away, that may simply be their answer, and it deserves respect. Distance is not a test you have to pass, and longing is not proof that a bond is destined. Many who hold this belief say a true soul connection would feel mutual and free, never like pursuit. So perhaps the kindest thing is to stop running after anyone, and turn back toward your own life. Whatever is meant to meet you can meet you there.
description: A reflection on the twin flame idea that honours respect and freedom: distance is an answer, not a test to pass.
